record.bible_text: Hear<WH08085><WTH8798> the word<WH01697> of the LORD<WH03068>, ye children<WH01121> of Israel<WH03478>: for the LORD<WH03068> hath a controversy<WH07379> with the inhabitants<WH03427><WTH8802> of the land<WH0776>, because <FI>there is<Fi> no truth<WH0571>, nor mercy<WH02617>, nor knowledge<WH01847> of God<WH0430> in the land<WH0776>.

By swearing<WH0422><WTH8800>, and lying<WH03584><WTH8763>, and killing<WH07523><WTH8800>, and stealing<WH01589><WTH8800>, and committing adultery<WH05003><WTH8800>, they break out<WH06555><WTH8804>, and blood<WH01818> toucheth<WH05060><WTH8804> blood<WH01818>. <RF>blood: Heb. bloods<Rf>

Therefore shall the land<WH0776> mourn<WH056><WTH8799>, and every one that dwelleth<WH03427><WTH8802> therein shall languish<WH0535><WTH8797>, with the beasts<WH02416> of the field<WH07704>, and with the fowls<WH05775> of heaven<WH08064>; yea, the fishes<WH01709> of the sea<WH03220> also shall be taken away<WH0622><WTH8735>.
Yet let no man<WH0376> strive<WH07378><WTH8799>, nor reprove<WH03198><WTH8686> another<WH0376>: for thy people<WH05971> <FI>are<Fi> as they that strive<WH07378><WTH8688> with the priest<WH03548>.

Therefore shalt thou fall<WH03782><WTH8804> in the day<WH03117>, and the prophet<WH05030> also shall fall<WH03782><WTH8804> with thee in the night<WH03915>, and I will destroy<WH01820><WTH8804> thy mother<WH0517>. <RF>destroy: Heb. cut off<Rf><CM>

My people<WH05971> are destroyed<WH01820><WTH8738> for lack of knowledge<WH01847>: because thou hast rejected<WH03988><WTH8804> knowledge<WH01847>, I will also reject<WH03988><WTH8799> thee, that thou shalt be no priest<WH03547><WTH8763> to me: seeing thou hast forgotten<WH07911><WTH8799> the law<WH08451> of thy God<WH0430>, I will also forget<WH07911><WTH8799> thy children<WH01121>. <RF>destroyed: Heb. cut off<Rf>
As they were increased<WH07230>, so they sinned<WH02398><WTH8804> against me: <FI>therefore<Fi> will I change<WH04171><WTH8686> their glory<WH03519> into shame<WH07036>.
They eat up<WH0398><WTH8799> the sin<WH02403> of my people<WH05971>, and they set<WH05375><WTH8799> their heart<WH05315> on their iniquity<WH05771>. <RF>set...: Heb. lift up their soul to<Rf>

And there shall be, like people<WH05971>, like priest<WH03548>: and I will punish<WH06485><WTH8804> them for their ways<WH01870>, and reward<WH07725><WTH8686> them their doings<WH04611>. <RF>punish: Heb. visit upon<Rf> <RF>reward: Heb. cause to return<Rf>

For they shall eat<WH0398><WTH8804>, and not have enough<WH07646><WTH8799>: they shall commit whoredom<WH02181><WTH8689>, and shall not increase<WH06555><WTH8799>: because they have left off<WH05800><WTH8804> to take heed<WH08104><WTH8800> to the LORD<WH03068>.
Whoredom<WH02184> and wine<WH03196> and new wine<WH08492> take away<WH03947><WTH8799> the heart<WH03820>.<CM>

My people<WH05971> ask<WH07592><WTH8799> counsel at their stocks<WH06086>, and their staff<WH04731> declareth<WH05046><WTH8686> unto them: for the spirit<WH07307> of whoredoms<WH02183> hath caused <FI>them<Fi> to err<WH08582><WTH8689>, and they have gone a whoring<WH02181><WTH8799> from under their God<WH0430>.

They sacrifice<WH02076><WTH8762> upon the tops<WH07218> of the mountains<WH02022>, and burn incense<WH06999><WTH8762> upon the hills<WH01389>, under oaks<WH0437> and poplars<WH03839> and elms<WH0424>, because the shadow<WH06738> thereof <FI>is<Fi>  good<WH02896>: therefore your daughters<WH01323> shall commit whoredom<WH02181><WTH8799>, and your spouses<WH03618> shall commit adultery<WH05003><WTH8762>.

I will not punish<WH06485><WTH8799> your daughters<WH01323> when they commit whoredom<WH02181><WTH8799>, nor your spouses<WH03618> when they commit adultery<WH05003><WTH8762>: for themselves are separated<WH06504><WTH8762> with whores<WH02181><WTH8802>, and they sacrifice<WH02076><WTH8762> with harlots<WH06948>: therefore the people<WH05971> <FI>that<Fi> doth not understand<WH0995><WTH8799> shall fall<WH03832><WTH8735>. <RF>I will not: or, Shall I not<Rf> <RF>fall: or, be punished<Rf>

Though thou, Israel<WH03478>, play the harlot<WH02181><WTH8802>, <FI>yet<Fi> let not Judah<WH03063> offend<WH0816><WTH8799>; and come<WH0935><WTH8799> not ye unto Gilgal<WH01537>, neither go ye up<WH05927><WTH8799> to Bethaven<WH01007>, nor swear<WH07650><WTH8735>, The LORD<WH03068> liveth<WH02416>.

For Israel<WH03478> slideth back<WH05637><WTH8804> as a backsliding<WH05637><WTH8802> heifer<WH06510>: now the LORD<WH03068> will feed<WH07462><WTH8799> them as a lamb<WH03532> in a large place<WH04800>.
Ephraim<WH0669> <FI>is<Fi> joined<WH02266><WTH8803> to idols<WH06091>: let him alone<WH03240><WTH8685>.

Their drink<WH05435> is sour<WH05493><WTH8804>: they have committed whoredom<WH02181><WTH8689> continually<WH02181><WTH8687>: her rulers<WH04043> <FI>with<Fi> shame<WH07036> do love<WH0157><WTH8804>, Give<WH03051><WTH8798> ye. <RF>sour: Heb. gone<Rf> <RF>rulers: Heb. shields<Rf>
The wind<WH07307> hath bound her up<WH06887><WTH8804> in her wings<WH03671>, and they shall be ashamed<WH0954><WTH8799> because of their sacrifices<WH02077>.<CM>
